summary: 6 browser check artifacts covering the 5 acceptance criteria (2 checks for the highlights-render criterion split into render + sync). Backend suite: 23 passed (pre-existing, no new backend-bearing criteria this round). Browser checks: 5 passed, 1 failed (advisor-note focus not set when the AI dialogue opens).

checks.criterion: Deal Highlights is a real rendered preview rather than placeholder text
checks.name: deal-highlights-renders-real-preview
checks.evidence: deal-highlights-render visible; deal-highlights-product ('Knock Out Conv. (LEV)') and deal-highlights-pair non-empty; deal-highlights-key-terms contains 6 .preview-metric nodes (>=3 required); deal-highlights-benefit and deal-highlights-risk both non-empty text.

checks.criterion: Deal Highlights stays synchronized with Deal Inputs
checks.name: deal-highlights-sync-with-inputs
checks.evidence: Editing deal-notional-input to 'USD 9,876,543' immediately reflected in deal-highlights-key-terms; editing dynamic field deal-dynamic-protection-input (non-date) to 'tscheck-dyn-42' also reflected immediately; switching product to Accumulator changed deal-highlights-product text and produced a non-empty deal-highlights-benefit for the new product.

checks.criterion: Full Termsheet and Deal Highlights tabs both work
checks.name: termsheet-and-highlights-tabs-switch
checks.evidence: Default tab renders full-termsheet-render with chip text 'FULL TERMSHEET' and full-termsheet-outline populated; clicking fmtTabHighlights swaps to deal-highlights-render with chip 'DEAL HIGHLIGHTS' and visible benefit; clicking fmtTabFull switches back to full-termsheet-render with chip reverted to 'FULL TERMSHEET'.

checks.criterion: Open AI dialogue works from the embedded AI guidance card
checks.name: open-ai-dialogue-from-guidance-card
checks.evidence: ai-guidance-open-dialogue-button click correctly opens ai-dialogue-box (aria-hidden true->false, visible) and sets aria-expanded=true on the button; BUT document.activeElement remains 'openAiFromGuidance' (the trigger button) instead of moving to #aiNote (ai-advisor-note-input) — expect(note).toBeFocused() timed out after 5000ms. Close button behavior (aria-hidden reset, aria-expanded=false) was verified separately in the pre-existing ai-dialogue-controls-and-close check and passed.

checks.criterion: The fixed workflow has no duplicate interactive test identifiers or browser errors
checks.name: workflow-unique-testids-no-console-errors
checks.evidence: deal-notional-input count === 1; full-page data-testid duplicate scan returned []; ran the full tab-switch + open/close AI dialogue workflow with zero console errors and zero network responses >=400 captured.

bugs.criterion: Open AI dialogue works from the embedded AI guidance card
bugs.description: openPopup() in demo/app.js calls els.note.focus() synchronously inside the button's click handler, but the browser's default post-click focus-the-clicked-button behavior runs after the handler and overrides it, so focus lands back on the 'Open AI dialogue' button instead of the advisor note textarea (#aiNote). Confirmed via page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.id) returning 'openAiFromGuidance' after the click, not 'aiNote'.
bugs.evidence: run_browser_script 'open-ai-dialogue-from-guidance-card': expect(page.locator('#aiNote')).toBeFocused() failed with 'Received: inactive' after 5000ms; screenshot confirms dialogue is visibly open (fully rendered, correct content) at the moment of failure, so this is a focus-management bug, not a render bug. Cross-checked with a manual page.evaluate probe returning activeElement.id === 'openAiFromGuidance'.

action_items.item: Fix advisor-note auto-focus on AI dialogue open: defer els.note.focus() to the next tick (e.g. requestAnimationFrame or a 0ms setTimeout) inside openPopup() in demo/app.js so it is not overridden by the browser's default button-focus-after-click behavior.

notes: Deal Highlights feature (previously placeholder per prior briefings) is now a real, schema-driven render — data-testid contract (deal-highlights-render/product/pair/key-terms/benefit/risk) matches the briefing and is fully live.

Global notional (deal-notional-input) and dynamic per-product fields (deal-dynamic-<key>-input) already use distinct, unique testids — no duplicate-id defect found; the workflow-level duplicate scan across the whole DOM also returned zero duplicates.
aria-expanded/aria-hidden wiring and the close-button reset for the AI dialogue are correct; only the focus-the-textarea step is broken.
Backend suite (23 tests, pre-existing) re-run clean with no changes required; no new API-backed criteria were introduced in this iteration's briefing.
